title: A Necessary and Sufficient Condition for Size Controllability of Heteroskedasticity Robust Test Statistics
abstract: We revisit size controllability results in Pötscher and Preinerstorfer (2025) concerning heteroskedasticity robust test statistics in regression models. For the special, but important, case of testing a single restriction (e.g., a zero restriction on a single coefficient), we povide a necessary and sufficient condition for size controllability, whereas the condition in Pötscher and Preinerstorfer (2025) is, in general, only sufficient (even in the case of testing a single restriction).
